name: The Minish Cap Pack (Link & Zelda + 3D Hyrule & Dark World)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Playable Young Link (OOT cries) & Princess Zelda, 6 Wardrobe skins each, shared exclusive Minish Cap moves + Light Arrows Fusion, and 3D Hyrule Castle & Pyramid of Power maps.
description: Complete Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap expansion featuring both Young Link (with iconic Ocarina of Time battle cries) and Princess Zelda (both unlocked by default) — each with full 8-direction animated sprites, functional Dual Shinies + 4 Wardrobe variant skins (Zora Blue, Goron Red, Four Sword Violet, Dark Link; Royal Sapphire, Sheikah Shadow, Twilight Princess, Triforce of Wisdom), 9 exclusive shared Minish Cap Sword & Item attacks (zero vanilla Pokémon moves), Light Arrows Primary Fusion, custom Ultimates, and 2 unlocked stages with full 3D Hyrule Castle and 3D Pyramid of Power landmarks + looping ALttP SNES soundtracks.
highlights: Playable Young Link (#2010, authentic OOT 3D battle cries) & Princess Zelda (#2024, Sacred Triforce Harp cry) — both unlocked by default

6 functional Wardrobe skins each: Classic Shiny, Hue Shiny, plus 4 iconic unlocked variants (Zora Blue, Goron Red, Four Sword Violet, Dark Link; Sapphire, Sheikah Shadow, Twilight, Triforce of Wisdom)
Exclusive shared Hyrule family moveset (9 Minish Cap Sword & Item attacks + Light Arrows Signature Fusion) — zero vanilla PokéBonk attacks
2 unlocked Zelda stages with true 3D Hyrule Castle & 3D Pyramid of Power landmarks, solid collision, and looping ALttP Overworld & Dark World SNES OSTs
